title: The Fairmile coach arrives later
setting: The operations manager of a boutique hotel

events.from: Clara Voss (owner, The Linden House Hotel)
events.text: Once a group has signed its booking form, its dates, number of rooms and price can't be changed without the group organiser's written agreement.

events.from: Clara Voss (owner, The Linden House Hotel)
events.text: Any order with an outside supplier over $1,000 needs my sign-off before it's placed or changed.
Housekeeping rotas, room set-ups and smaller supplier bookings are the operations office's to arrange and adjust. You don't need to check with me; just make sure the people involved are told.

events.from: Clara Voss (owner, The Linden House Hotel)
events.text: Fairmile Architects found us through the Leeds design awards. Let's look after them; they could become regulars.

Signed group booking form: Fairmile Architects' team retreat at The Linden House Hotel, 12 rooms for the night of Thursday 19 November, dinner for 14 in the Garden Room on the Thursday at 19:30, and the Library for a workshop on Friday 20 November from 09:00 to 13:00. $3,960 in total.
Entered the Fairmile Architects retreat as confirmed: 12 rooms for the night of Thursday 19 November, $3,960, organiser Hannah Webb.
Booked the Garden Room for the Fairmile dinner: Thursday 19 November at 19:30, one long table for 14.
Booked the Library for the Fairmile workshop: Friday 20 November, 09:00 to 13:00, set boardroom-style for 14.
The Garden Room seats up to 20 at one long table.
For the Fairmile dinner I'll do a set three-course menu. I need final numbers a week before.
Projector, screen and two microphones for the Library on Friday 20 November, set up by 08:30, $340.
Booked Brightcast AV for the Fairmile workshop: projector, screen and two microphones in the Library, set up by 08:30 on Friday 20 November, $340.
Set the housekeeping rota for Thursday 19 November: as for every group, Ivo Novak's team will have all 12 Fairmile rooms ready by 14:00, an hour before our standard 15:00 check-in.
Travel plan: the team is coming down together by coach from Leeds and should get to you at about 15:00 on Thursday 19 November. We're arranging the coach ourselves.
Table flowers for a dinner of 14: three low arrangements, $150, delivered by 16:00 on the day.
Ordered three low table arrangements from Wren Flowers for the Fairmile dinner in the Garden Room, delivered by 16:00 on Thursday 19 November, $150.
To do: send Fairmile the deposit invoice by Friday 14 August. Done today.
Extra linen for your 12-room group: delivered on Wednesday 18 November, $180.
Ordered extra linen from Crisp Linen Services for the Fairmile rooms, delivered on Wednesday 18 November, $180.

Fairmile retreat briefing for the team: all 12 rooms ready by 14:00 on Thursday 19 November, dinner for 14 in the Garden Room at 19:30, workshop in the Library on Friday 20 November from 09:00, with Brightcast set up by 08:30.
Marco rang: he's planning a winter menu with venison for the Fairmile dinner.
We'd love the Garden Room for our ruby anniversary dinner on Saturday 21 November at 19:00, 16 of us.
Booked the Garden Room for the Hartwell anniversary dinner: Saturday 21 November at 19:00, for 16.
Our technician for the Library set-up will be Kev.

I got our travel time wrong in my August email, sorry: the coach can't leave Leeds until after lunch, so the team will get to you at about 16:30 on Thursday 19 November, not 15:00. We're still arranging the coach ourselves.
Just confirming our anniversary dinner in the Garden Room on Saturday 21 November at 19:00, 16 of us. We'll bring our own cake!
The new pillows have arrived and are in the linen room.
Could you send me the dinner and workshop timings, and which rooms they're in, so I can put them in the team's itinerary?
Marco has the Fairmile menu cards printed.

records.title: Extra linen for the Fairmile rooms

task: Please send Hannah at Fairmile the times and the rooms for her team's dinner on Thursday 19 November and their workshop on Friday 20 November.
why: Hannah's correction moves the team's coach arrival from about 15:00 to about 16:30, but no decision rests on her August travel note: the rooms are ready by 14:00 because of the hotel's standard 15:00 check-in, and the dinner, workshop, flowers, linen and AV all follow the signed booking form. Nothing is touched and no record changes; the task is done on the plan as it stands: dinner at 19:30 in the Garden Room, workshop from 09:00 in the Library.
